facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter, requiring another trial · Filed (NDA) · roluperidone in negative symptoms of schizophrenia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a Complete Response Letter (CRL) to the Company’s New Drug Application (NDA) for roluperidone for the treatment of negative symptoms in patients with schizophrenia.
evidence.safety: The submitted safety database included an inadequate number of subjects exposed to roluperidone at the proposed dose (64 mg) for at least 12 months.
